items.title: Kimchi Stew 🍲
items.fact: Kimchi stew is rich in fibre and warms you up.
narration: I'm Halmoni, let's cook together. Look closely at the ingredients.
First, heat some oil in a pot, then add the kimchi. Next, add the pork and tofu.
Now, add the gochujang and garlic, and stir well. Bring the stew to a boil.
Kimchi stew is not only delicious, but also gentle on the stomach. It's a traditional Korean dish.
Thanks for cooking with me, see you tomorrow for more recipes. Look closely for new videos.
items.description:
Learn how to make a delicious and traditional Korean kimchi stew with Halmoni. The ingredients include kimchi, pork, tofu, gochujang, and garlic. What's your favorite way to eat kimchi stew? Share with us in the comments.

items.title: Hydrate 💧
items.fact: Drinking enough water helps maintain physical health and energy levels.
narration: I start my day with water, Che bello! It's essential for me.
I drink at least eight glasses a day, spread out evenly. It's a simple habit to get into.
Water helps my body function properly, from digestion to skin health. It's a natural remedy.
Staying hydrated boosts my energy and mood, making every day more enjoyable. It's a small change with big benefits.
So, remember to drink plenty of water, and don't forget to ask your doctor about your personal health questions, see you tomorrow!

items.title: Nani's Balance 🧘
items.fact: Regular chair balance exercises improve overall balance and reduce the risk of falls in older adults.
items.activity: her garden on a yoga mat
narration: I'm Nani, let's exercise together. Shall we find out?
Hold a sturdy chair, lift one leg, hold for 3 seconds. Do it 10 times on each side slowly.
Move slowly, don't rush, and breathe normally. Stop if you feel any discomfort or pain.
This exercise improves balance, flexibility, and circulation. It's great for older adults like me.
Thanks for exercising with me, see you tomorrow for more fun. Shall we find out?
